description: This file contains a PHP class 'Periodic' that implements financial functions related to cash flows with constant payments and interest rates, such as calculating future value, present value, and the number of periods. It is part of the PHPSpreadsheet project and is within the calculation calculation modules for financial cash flow computations.

classes.name: Periodic
classes.description: Provides static methods to compute various financial cash flow metrics such as future value, present value, and period count for serial cash flows with constant interest rate and payment.

methods.name: futureValue
methods.description: Calculates the future value of a series of cash flows with constant payments and interest rate, according to the FV function in Excel.

methods.name: presentValue
methods.description: Calculates the present value of a series of future cash flows with constant payments and interest rate, similar to the PV function in Excel.

methods.name: periods
methods.description: Calculates the number of periods for a series of cash flows given the interest rate and payment parameters, analogous to the NPER function in Excel.

methods.name: calculateFutureValue
methods.description: Private helper method calculating future value based on rate, periods, payment, present value, and type.

methods.name: calculatePresentValue
methods.description: Private helper method calculating present value based on rate, periods, payment, future value, and type.

methods.name: calculatePeriods
methods.description: Private helper method calculating the number of periods based on rate, payment, present value, future value, and type.
